title: PacPack Aroma Server
description: A 100% Vanilla-compatible Fabric server pack featuring breathtaking world-gen, dungeons, and essential utilities.
body:
# PacPack Aroma Server

A standalone, high-performance Fabric server modpack meticulously configured for Minecraft **26.1.2**. 

**PacPack Aroma Server** is built from the ground up to completely overhaul world generation, structures, and multiplayer mechanics while remaining **100% compatible with any standard, unmodded Vanilla client**. Anyone can join your server without installing a single mod. 

> **💡 The Ultimate Combo:** While this server pack works flawlessly with raw Vanilla clients, it is highly recommended to pair it with the [PacPack Aroma](https://modrinth.com/modpack/pacpack-aroma) client modpack. They are fully compatible and together they unlock next-level visual syncing, deep audio immersion, and client-side performance.

![New terrain generation with high hills and new biomes](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9e8535ffa3959caad0f7d7cb2c11e2cad1d03f2d.jpeg)

## ✨ Features

*   **🌍 Breathtaking World Generation (No Blocks Added):** Reimagines all three dimensions using data-driven generation that vanilla clients can render perfectly. Powered by **Terralith** and **Tectonic** for majestic mountain ranges, **Incendium** for a hyper-detailed Nether, and **Nullscape** for a vast, atmospheric End.
*   **🏰 Dungeons & Exploration:** Expands the world's points of interest with **Dungeons and Taverns**, **Towns and Towers**, and **MoogsEndStructures**. Exploration feels incredibly rewarding and fresh, with zero client-side requirements.
*   **🚀 Enterprise-Grade Optimization:** Keeps your MSPT (Milliseconds Per Tick) low and your TPS high under heavy player loads. Includes **Lithium** (general physics/AI optimization), **Noisium** (ultra-fast world generation scaling), **FerriteCore** (RAM reduction), **ScalableLux** (optimized lighting engine), and **LetMeDespawn** to eliminate passive entity clutter.
*   **⚙️ Multiplayer Essentials:** Replaces heavy plugins with a lightweight, native command suite via the **Blossom** series (**BlossomTpa**, **BlossomHomes**, **BlossomWarps**, **BlossomBack**). It also includes automated world saves via **Just Enough Backups**, clean tablists with **TAB**, and building tools like **WorldEdit**.
*   **🔒 Pre-Enabled Permissions Stack:** Powered by **LuckPerms** and **Vanilla Permissions**. This allows server administrators to grant normal players access to specific vanilla commands (like `/time` or `/gamemode`) and Blossom utility commands without having to make them full Server Operators (OP).
*   **🌾 Seamless QoL & Client Syncing:** Includes subtle gameplay enhancers like **Veinminer**, **FallingTree**, **Right Click Harvest**, **Double Doors**, **Sit!**, and **Spawn Animations**. For players running the *PacPack Aroma* client, the server includes **Voxy World Gen V2** to stream Level-of-Detail (LOD) blocks for infinite render distances, alongside automatic syncing for **JEI**, **Jade**, and **Journeymap**.

---

## 💡 Server Administrator Tips

*   **Vanilla Player Access:** Because all terrain and structure modifications use vanilla blocks and tags, players using a standard Minecraft launcher can connect instantly. They will experience the new world generation and structures seamlessly.
*   **Command Permissions:** Use LuckPerms (`/lp group default permission set ...`) to manage access to vanilla commands or Blossom utilities for your player base without hand out OP security risks.
*   **Voxy Streaming:** The inclusion of **Voxy World Gen V2** allows the server to process background chunk layouts specifically for *PacPack Aroma* client users, enabling them to see miles into the distance without lagging the main server thread.

---
If you encounter any issue, feel free to come on Discord and describe your problem.

*Developed by the PacPack Team. Thank you for using our modpack!*
